name: Mobbin
description: Mobbin is the industry standard in UI & UX design references for mobile apps, web apps, and websites. The platform serves millions of product builders and designers across the world to help them design better digital experiences. Connect Mobbin with Claude to better research and explore UI & UX design ideas.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mobbin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mobbin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.mobbin.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mobbin MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mobbin provides these MCP tools: search_flows, search_screens, and search_sections.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mobbin?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mobbin in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Mobbin requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mobbin is developed by Mobbin. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
